confirm.title: Confirm your subscription
confirm.description: Confirm your subscription to the Private Dispatch Journal — seasonal notes from your Sri Lanka guide.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.description: Unsubscribe from the Private Dispatch Journal.

loading.title: Confirming your subscription…
loading.body: One moment while I check your link.

confirmed.title: Welcome to the Private Dispatch Journal
confirmed.body: Your subscription is confirmed. A few times a year I will send you seasonal notes on wildlife migrations, festival dates and new routes — never spam, and you can unsubscribe with one click.

already.title: You're already subscribed
already.body: This link has been used before and your subscription is active — there is nothing more to do.

invalid.title: This link is invalid or has expired
invalid.body: Confirmation links work only for your latest sign-up and stop working once you unsubscribe. Enter your email below and I will send you a fresh link.

loading.title: Unsubscribing…
loading.body: One moment while I update your preferences.

unsubscribed.title: You have been unsubscribed
unsubscribed.body: I have removed your address from the Private Dispatch Journal — you will not receive further newsletters. Changed your mind? You can subscribe again below at any time.

invalid.title: This unsubscribe link is invalid
invalid.body: The link may be incomplete — please open it again from the email, or copy the full address. If you keep receiving newsletters, write to me and I will remove you personally.

network.title: I couldn't reach the server
network.body: Please check your internet connection and try again.

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
rateLimited.body: Please wait a minute and try again.

server.title: Something went wrong on my side
server.body: Please try again in a moment — or message me on WhatsApp and I will sort it out.
